entries.title: Ask HN: What are some books where the reader learns by building projects?
entries.author: Shosty123
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some books where the reader learns by building projects?
entries.excerpt: A continuation of https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=13660086 which has been incredibly useful to me. I recently finished this phenomenal book called "Building Enterprise JavaScript Applications": https://www.packtpub.com/web-development/building-enterprise-javascript-applications Which takes the reader from zero to building a non-trivial production fullstack application with JavaScript. I also recommend "Building Git". The title is self-explanatory: https://shop.jcoglan.co
entries.guide_zh: 边做项目边学的书有哪些，寻找让读者通过动手构建掌握知识的教材。

entries.current_title: Ask HN: Advice for a new and inexperienced tech lead?

entries.guide_zh: 中级开发者首次承担技术负责人角色，如何组建团队并做好带队工作？

entries.title: Ask HN: What are good solo developer blogs that you enjoy reading?
entries.author: lucasfdacunha
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are good solo developer blogs that you enjoy reading?
entries.excerpt: Hey guys, I like to read blog bosts about developers that run some kind of project (rentable or not) and usually are pretty open about its development and how things are going. However, it's really hard to find some of those, unless you found those somewhere. Hacker Newsletter today had a pretty good article https://mtlynch.io/solo-developer-year-2/ I'm mostly looking for something similar since this kind of blog post can give some good insights. Thanks.
entries.guide_zh: 征集独立开发者博客，尤其想看公开记录项目开发与运营过程的作者。

entries.title: Ask HN: What job can a “jack of all trades” look for?
entries.author: programbreeding
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What job can a “jack of all trades” look for?
entries.excerpt: tl;dnr: Unhappy at my job after >7 years. Love being a jack of all trades. Love learning new things. Hate being stagnant. Hate being the smartest person in the room. Need something new. What roles out there fit the skill set of someone that is good at a whole lot of things, but doesn't feel like a master/senior in any one of them? - I've been at the same small company for over 7 years. I started at the bottom, worked my way to the top after 3 years, and I've been here since.
entries.guide_zh: 喜欢广泛学习、厌倦停滞的多面手，应该寻找怎样的工作岗位？

entries.title: Ask HN: What's the best resource for learning modern x64 assembly?
entries.author: ssklash
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What's the best resource for learning modern x64 assembly?
entries.excerpt: I've found lots of resources for x86, but considerably less for x64. Pentester Academy has a promising course on it, along with shellcoding, but I'm not sure what else is out there.
entries.guide_zh: 学习现代 x64 汇编该用哪些资料，发帖者希望超越常见的 x86 教程。

entries.title: Ask HN: A major USA bank is storing passwords in cleartext – what to do?
entries.author: plsdonthack
entries.current_title: Ask HN: A major USA bank is storing passwords in cleartext – what to do?
entries.excerpt: I was having trouble accessing my account, so I gave a call to customer service. The service rep proceeded to (accurately) describe my own password to me. Should I report this somewhere? I'm not really sure what to do.
entries.guide_zh: 客服能说出用户密码，发帖者怀疑美国某银行明文存储，询问如何处理。

entries.title: Ask HN: What are some examples of good database schema designs?
entries.author: vanilla-almond
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some examples of good database schema designs?
entries.excerpt: I've seen many examples of database schemas but don't always recognise a good design over a mediocre or poor design. This is what I mean by schema (is this a good design?) https://www.drupal.org/node/1785994 When I read about database schemas with thousands of tables I wonder what kind of problem could possibly require so many tables. What are good schema examples? And what are some poor examples?
entries.guide_zh: 怎样识别数据库表结构设计的好坏，征集可供学习比较的优秀实例。

entries.title: Ask HN: What automation tools have you used to replace mundane activities?

A LOT of that becomes tedious. Mailchimp can auto post to FB/twitter/
